text: Cooperate with Fisayo: second session where Felix walks him through setting up Aimparency on his computer
description:
Felix 2026-11-09, during the call with Fisayo: the idea of cooperating, starting with a second session in which Felix walks Fisayo through setting up the project on his own computer.

Setup checklist for the session (from the README): Node.js 22.13+ and git; `git clone https://github.com/aimparency/v7.git && cd v7 && corepack enable && pnpm install`; `pnpm dev` and open http://localhost:4000; first browse v7's own graph, then `pnpm dev <path to one of his repos>` to create its .bowman; optionally connect his coding agent through the MCP (packages/mcp/README.md). Note what is unclear or breaks for him: that is the first outside-user feedback (8f002aaf).

status.comment: Felix: agree a date for the second session with Fisayo; setup checklist in the description.
